summary: Pin an instance to specific instance groups only: add it to each group's policy_instance_list and PATCH the instance's managed_by_policy to False so percentage and minimum policies do not add it to other groups.
questions: How do I pin an instance to a specific instance group?
What does managed_by_policy do on an instance?
Stop an instance joining groups by percentage policy
How do I set policy_instance_list through the API?

answer_card.title: Pin an instance to an instance group
answer_card.answer_md:
Add the instance to the group's list, then take it out of policy management:

```
HTTP PATCH /api/v2/instance_groups/N/
{"policy_instance_list": ["special-instance"]}

HTTP PATCH /api/v2/instances/X/
{"managed_by_policy": false}
```

The instance then belongs only to the groups you assigned it to.
